title: Zapotin mitigates breast cancer progression by targeting PKCepsilon mediated glycolytic pathway regulation.
authors: Khan, Khushbukhat; Anwar, Maryam; Badshah, Yasmin; Ashraf, Naeem Mahmood; Hamid, Arslan; Trembley, Janeen H; Shabbir, Maria; Afsar, Tayyaba; Husain, Fohad Mabood; Khan, Dilawar; Razak, Suhail
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨Zapotin通过靶向PKCepsilon调控乳腺癌糖酵解通路，属于蛋白-小分子互作与代谢研究，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The breast cancer recurrence and chemoresistance has increased over the years. A novel PKC, PKCepsilon, may promote chemoresistance by causing hypoxia and cancer metabolic rewiring. A natural flavonoid, Zapotin, in colon cancer cells may modulate PKCepsilon expression. Therefore, this study aimed to explore Zapotin impact on PKCepsilon expression and the metabolic profile of breast cancer cells. METHODS: Pharmacophore analysis of Zapotin was performed and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations were employed to study PKCepsilon and Zapotin interaction stability. The effect of Zapotin treatment on PKCepsilon expression and various aspects of cancer cell viability and metabolism was studied in MCF-7 and MDA-MB-231 breast cancer cell lines using real-time PCR, growth and death assays, and Gas Chromatography-Mass Spectrometry. RESULTS: In silico analyses revealed good solubility and absorption of Zapotin with lower toxicity. Zapotin showed cancer cell-specific cytotoxicity (P < 0.0001). It's treatment also reduced breast cancer cell viability, colony formation, and migratory potential by targeting PKCepsilon and associated HIF-1a and VEGF signaling (P < 0.01). Zapotin also impacted PKCepsilon-mediated metabolic signaling by targeting glycolytic pathways. CONCLUSION: This study demonstrated the role of PKCepsilon mediated HIF-1a, VEGF, and glycolytic pathways in promoting breast carcinogenicity and demonstrated Zapotin as a potential treatment option for different types of breast tumors.
abstract_zh: 背景：近年来，乳腺癌复发和化疗耐药性有所增加。一种新型蛋白激酶C（PKC）亚型——PKCepsilon，可能通过诱导缺氧和癌症代谢重编程来促进化疗耐药性。一种天然黄酮类化合物Zapotin在结肠癌细胞中可能调节PKCepsilon的表达。因此，本研究旨在探讨Zapotin对乳腺癌细胞中PKCepsilon表达及代谢谱的影响。方法：对Zapotin进行了药效团分析，并采用分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟研究PKCepsilon与Zapotin相互作用的稳定性。在MCF-7和MDA-MB-231乳腺癌细胞系中，通过实时PCR、生长和死亡检测以及气相色谱-质谱联用技术，研究了Zapotin处理对PKCepsilon表达及癌细胞活力和代谢各方面的影响。结果：计算机模拟分析显示Zapotin具有良好的溶解性和吸收性，且毒性较低。Zapotin表现出癌细胞特异性细胞毒性（P < 0.0001）。其处理还通过靶向PKCepsilon及相关HIF-1a和VEGF信号通路，降低了乳腺癌细胞活力、集落形成和迁移能力（P < 0.01）。Zapotin还通过靶向糖酵解途径影响PKCepsilon介导的代谢信号。结论：本研究证明了PKCepsilon介导的HIF-1a、VEGF和糖酵解通路在促进乳腺癌致癌性中的作用，并表明Zapotin可作为不同类型乳腺肿瘤的潜在治疗选择。
